title: Earlier aquarium risk detection
question: Can inexpensive continuous signals reveal developing aquarium risk earlier or more meaningfully than periodic testing alone?
hypothesis: Continuous temperature, pH and conductivity signals combined with reference tests and care events may expose developing risk earlier than periodic tests alone.
provenance: VELYQUA README physical sensor-fusion hypothesis and evidence boundary
evidence_boundary: The VELYQUA product is a working prototype; the physical sensor-fusion early-warning hypothesis remains unvalidated until real observations accumulate.
